url = "https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1"
todo_file = "todo.txt"

# Fetch JSON data from the URL

    data = response.read()
    json_data = data.decode('utf-8')

# Extract the 'title' from the JSON
todo_title = json.loads(json_data)["title"]

# Write the title to 'todo.txt'
